articles.title: IndiGo’s cost advantage stands out as global airline comparison shows why low-cost carriers earn more
articles.summary: IndiGo recorded an EBITDA margin of 25% in FY26, broadly in line with its 24% margin in FY25 and 25% in FY24. This compares with 13% for Delta and United Airlines, while American Airlines reported an EBITDA margin of just 6% in FY25/26.

articles.summary: Mercedes-Benz has launched the ₹3.35 crore Maybach S 580e in India with 585hp, a 98km electric range and four-seat luxury. Only 30 units will be available at launch.

articles.summary: In a letter dated October 2, IBAI asked the Finance Minister not to notify regulations on commission and expense limits without a published impact assessment, and sought continuation of the existing 2023 framework until its scheduled review in 2028.

articles.summary: Gold price prediction today: Easing October Fed rate hike probability, soft US nonfarm payroll report (September) and robust ETF inflows support the shiny metal; however, elevated yields and firm oil prices amid healthy risk appetite cap the gains.

articles.title: Rupee falls to 96.39 against dollar as oil rises, FII outflows continue
articles.summary: The rupee faced downward pressure against the US dollar, dropping to 96.39 early in the trading session. This decline stems from rising crude oil prices and ongoing selling by foreign investors. Despite this, domestic equities saw gains, softening the rupee's fall.

articles.summary: In a nuanced twist, South Korea has been sending considerable quantities of diesel fuel to Russia even as it lends support to Ukraine amidst the ongoing invasion. Recent months have seen multiple shipments, indicating a complex dynamic between the two nations.

articles.summary: India plans to sign a bilateral investment treaty with Saudi Arabia, allowing quicker arbitration for investors. The exhaustion of legal remedies period has been reduced from five years to two years for Saudi Arabia.
